🎖 This week on TSN Talks… we sit down with one of the few Thai-Indian soldiers serving our beautiful country, Thailand. 

Major Sukit Khurana takes us inside his unique journey as one of Thailand’s few Thai-Indian soldiers — the discipline, the purpose, and the values that keep him grounded. 

In this episode, we talk about his decision to serve, the highs and lows of military life, identity and representation, and the responsibilities (and the pride) that comes with serving as a Thai-Indian soldier. 

📺 Full episode live TONIGHT on TSN Talks YouTube. Tune IN! 

#TSNTalks

🚨 This week on TSN Talks… we sit down with Harprem Doowa (@harprem)— the entrepreneur behind PetLoft, Frank.co, and now Eazy Digital.

In this episode, we talk about his journey from employee to founder, early failures, building Frank from the ground up, navigating a major exit, and starting again with Eazy Digital. Harprem breaks down the real reality of building products inside Thailand’s startup ecosystem. 

We talk about rejection, resilience, cross-culture lessons, and the real beginning of his entrepreneurial journey. 

From graduating and taking his first job, to pursuing an MBA at Sasin, to launching PetLoft as his first step into entrepreneurship — Harprem shares how each chapter shaped his mindset. We also dive into the his journey and rise with Frank.co, one of Southeast Asia’s first digital insurance platforms, how it scaled, and what came after the big exit.

📺 Full episode Live NOW on TSN Talks YouTube.

#TSNTalks

We’ve got some incredible guests coming up! Here’s a sneak peek of the next 4 👇

1️⃣ Sunny Khurana (@sunnykspark), Founder & CEO of @spark.love.official - Had a fascinating conversation with another Sunny - sold everything, moved to Bangkok, rebuilt his app FIVE times. We talk about resilience, taking risks, and how he’s bringing back real human connections via SPARK in a digital world.

2️⃣ Deepak Sajnani — President of the Thai Sindhi Association & former President of the India-Thai Chamber of Commerce (ITCC). A wonderful conversation about the importance of community with someone who’s spent over 40 years helping build and strengthen the Indian community in Thailand.

3️⃣ Angad Pasricha (@angadpasricha28) Founder of @humanstoriesthailand — a Columbia MBA Graduate on the importance of Storytelling and why he’s launching Human Stories on August 1, 2026.

4️⃣ Anand Koghar - Country Manager, @chargespot.th - An insightful chat on ChargeSPOT’s distribution strategy, scaling across Thailand, and how they’ve landed in locations like Siam Paragon and 7-Eleven.

Who should we invite to TSN Talks next? Let us know in the comments or DM 👇

🚨 This week on TSN Talks… Dr. Ravee Phol drops the kind of truth most parents aren’t ready to hear.
From the real cost of international schools in Thailand… to why Thai students often outperform… to the question parents should be asking before tuition: “What kind of person do you want your child to become?”

Dr. Ravee challenges everything parents assume about education — costs, outcomes, the Ivy League opportunities (or lack thereof), and why Thai schools may be far better than people admit. 

One of our most eye-opening conversations yet.

📺 Full episode LIVE TONIGHT on TSN Talks YouTube.

This week on TSN Talks, we sit down with the President of BNI – The One Chapter, Mr. Nathapol Sirinarang. 

After spending over 20 years working in the same industry, Nathapol reached a point where he wanted a fresh perspective, not just on business, but on people, collaboration, and growth. That journey led him to BNI, a global networking organization built on one simple philosophy: Givers Gain.

In this episode, we unpack what BNI really is and why structured networking can act as a “training center” for business owners. Nathapol shares how surrounding yourself with the right community can sharpen your thinking, challenge blind spots, and open doors you can’t unlock alone.

This is a conversation about collaboration over competition, learning through giving, and how strong businesses are built through relationships.

📺 Full episode live TONIGHT on TSN Talks YouTube.

🥗 This week on TSN Talks…we sit down with Anchit Sachdev, Co-Founder & MD of @getfreshth — the brand that is redefining healthy eating in Thailand.

Anchit takes us through his 14-year journey of making nutritious food truly accessible in Thailand — from the early challenges of working under a franchisor, to scaling across Bangkok, surviving Covid, and growing to 20+ outlets and canteen management partnerships with leading international schools.

 From finding local Thai farms to source organic ingredients from, to navigating operations in a rapidly changing F&B landscape, to building a team culture grounded in consistency and purpose - we unpack a few interesting topics in this conversation. 

More than just salads - this episode dives into what real impact looks like. Balancing growth with authenticity, and leading with purpose.

We love his approach and how he is building a new way for people connect and meet in real life, so we invited him on TSN TALKS! 

The heart of our conversation flows around why he believes dating apps are broken.
